description: Search the price lists of EKO-IKSI and its two partner clinics in Tashkent (IVF, ICSI, consultations, tests, procedures). Prices are in Uzbek so'm. Search works in Uzbek, Russian or English.

clinic.description: Only one clinic: eko-iksi (the main clinic), eko-iksi-ivf (partner clinic) or oilam (Oilam Medical Centre). Leave empty for all three.

language.description: Language of the answer: uz (Uzbek, the site's own language and the default), ru (Russian) or en (English).

limit.description: How many results to return (default 20, at most 50).

query.description: Words from the service name, in any of the three languages — e.g. "EKO", "ЭКО", "IVF", "androlog", "анализ". Leave empty to list services.

name: search_prices
title: Search prices
